Commentary.Commentary: Kumara once again got things going for the Islanders adding 3 wickets to the overnight tally of 3. Pradeep was still absent on the field and the Lankans were one bowler short. Now, they have to show that they can bat deep and not tumble as they did in the first innings of the 1st Test. Whereas, the Proteas will look to bowl the visitors out and take a healthy first innings' lead. Stay tuned as we return after the lunch break with the Sri Lankan batting!

South Africa added 95 runs in the morning before getting bowled out. Herath picked up Abbott in the second over of the day and began the day well for the visitors. But then a 33-run and 40-run partnership for the 8th and 9th wicket respectively frustrated the Lankans a touch. They had to extend the start of the lunch but required only 5 extra minutes to get things done.

After losing a wicket in the first over itself, the hosts came back strongly and posted a total of 392 on the board. Dean Elgar laid the foundation as he scored his 6th Test century and was involved in 3 healthy partnerships with Amla, du Plessis and de Kock. After his departure, the man in form Quinton de Kock carried on and completed his 3rd Test century! Lahiru Kumara was the pick of the bowlers for the Islanders with 6 wickets. Lakmal and Herath chipped in with a couple of wickets.

Welcome to the 2nd day of the 2nd Test between the Proteas and the Islanders. The visitors started the day brilliantly and won the first session but it was the hosts, who came out on top at the end of day's play courtesy a century and a half century from Dean Elgar and Quinton de Kock respectively. The latter is still out there in the middle and if he adds 100 runs more with the tail, South Africa would be in a position of real command. The Sri Lankan bowlers would look to spear through the last 4 Protea wickets, looking to restrict them below 350.
... DAY 2, SESSION 1 ...

That ends the opening day's play in the first Test of the new year. It has belonged to South Africa and they will be looking to build on the same, come Day 2. Can Sri Lanka come back hard and restrict the Proteas to 350, as they did on the second morning of the first Test? Or will the home side continue scoring runs quickly? De Kock was there then and he is here as well. Join us at 1400 IST (0830 GMT) to see how Day 2 unfolds. Before that, tomorrow, Australia and Pakistan start their third Test in Sydney. You can tune in to that match as well. Until then, ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

A tough day for the Lankans. Lahiru Kumara was the standout bowler for them, picking up 3 wickets while Suranga Lakmal struck early with both the new balls. Mathews and Herath bowled economically but by no means were threatening.

The day has belonged to Dean Elgar. He survived an excellent spell of bowling from the Lankans in the morning, then built on his start to make sure he got a big one. He held one end, making it South Africa's day before getting dismissed in the fag end of the day.

It seemed like the Lankans had gone flat in the afternoon. Nothing was happening, till they found a way past Faf du Plessis and then Bavuma. But de Kock came in and started playing his shots from the word go. The pair of Elgar and de Kock added 103 in just 143 balls for the 6th wicket with de Kock scoring 60 of those.

End of a fine day of cricket. Sri Lanka vindicated their decision to bowl first by nipping out three quick wickets in the morning, but then the 76-run stand between Dean Elgar and Faf du Plessis stalled them.

Full and down the leg side, de Kock looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
RANGANA HERATH it will be to bowl the remaining deliveries of this over.

Oh dear... this is not looking good. NUWAN PRADEEP IS WALKING OFF. After bowling that last ball, he had a chat with his skipper and then started to go off. Not quite sure what is the issue, because he seems to be fine. Might be a niggle somewhere.
On a good length around middle, angling in, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Flicks this through mid-wicket for a single.
Drives this through the covers for a run.
Pushes this in front of point and takes a run.
Outside off, another watchful block.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle and leg, worked to the leg side for a single.
6TH Test ton for Elgar, 2nd against Sri Lanka.

FOUR! Fine way to get to a century! Full and outside off, Elgar comes forward and drives it down the ground, beating mid off. The moment the ball goes past the fielder, Elgar raises his arms in celebration, running around in jubilation. It has been a quality knock. He scored a century at the WACA and has not failed that much but the big knock has been eluding him. Has been throwing away starts. This will make him feel a lot better.
Outside off, flayed through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, Elgar pushes it wide of mid off and takes a single to move to 98.
On a good length around off, defended watchfully.
Outside off, left alone.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
NUWAN PRADEEP is back on as well.
Comes down the track again but is not quite to the pitch of the ball and looks to defend. Gets an inside edge back to the bowler.

FOUR! GLORIOUS! That is a top quality shot. Flighted outside off, de Kock steps down the wicket and drives it all along the ground through the covers for a boundary. 200 UP FOR SOUTH AFRICA! The stand moves to 33 from 42 balls.
This is just outside off, de Kock comes forward and defends.
Around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
A short ball down the leg side, Elgar misses out, as he looks to pull.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA is back on.
FOUR! Short and outside off, de Kock lashes out a ferocious cut through point for a boundary. 12 from the over but Kumara could have had a wicket, if Mathews had been aggressive.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a couple.
Outside off, steered behind point for a single.
Outside off, a play and a miss.

EDGED, FOUR! Luck is not with Kumara, but why isn't there a third slip? He is bowling beautifully and deserves a packed slip cordon. Full and outside off, de Kock comes forward to drive but gets a thick outside edge which flies past second slip to the third man fence!
Outside off, let through.
Short and outside off, slapped through the covers for a single.

FOUR! Off the inside edge! This is because of the previous ball. That one came back in a long way and hence de Kock thought this one will too and pushed at it. The ball did not come in that much and went off the inside edge past the off stump to the fine leg fence. Moves to 12 with his first boundary.
Landed outside off, comes back in a long way, QdK lets it through.
Landed outside off, Quinton looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards point.
Full and outside off, de Kock drives it nicely, on the up and starts to run but then realizes that he has hit it too well towards mid off and goes back.
A bouncer around middle and off, Dean ducks.
Full and wide outside off, Dean lets it through.
Outside off, dabbed behind point for one.
Works it through mid-wicket for a run.
On a length, around middle and off, worked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Moves into the 90s now.
A short delivery around off, pulled away for a single.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
A short ball around off, pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and wide outside off, de Kock slaps it through point for a single.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Landed on a good length around off, angling in, defended from the crease back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A short ball around off, QdK pulls it nicely through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, Quinton defends watchfully.

NOT OUT! Impact outside off. It seemed like that to the naked eye as well. On a good length outside off, angling in, de Kock walked across his stumps and looked to flick but missed the ball, getting hit on the pads. Kumara was confident he had his man and appealed for LBW but the umpire shook his head. Mathews took the review but Hawk Eye confirmed the impact. Waste of a review. The keeper should have prevented Mathews from going for the review.
LBW REVIEW! Kumara thinks he has Quinton de Kock plumb in front. It has not been given and Mathews takes the review.
Outside off, cut straight to point.
Short and outside off, cut through point where the fielder dives to stop the ball. Just a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Wide outside off, short as well, de Kock flays a cut but misses.
Outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a couple.
So indeed it is a change of ends for Suranga Lakmal.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
QUINTON DE KOCK walks in at number 7, replacing Bavuma.

OUT! Taken in the deep! Kumara has his third! Excellent bowling. He tests Bavuma with the short ball and the batsman is not too comfortable with it. The ball is not that fast, just at 131.1 kph, but he is still hurried into the pull. He miscues it and the ball goes straight to deep backward square leg where Upul Tharanga takes it calmly and does not drop it this time. So Bavuma's failures continue. Has not quite been able to do much since his fifties in Perth and Hobart. Struggled even in domestic cricket, managing a highest of just 33 in 9 innings before this.
Goes back in his crease and defends.
Outside off, left alone.
On a good length outside off, Dean looks to play it with a straight bat but gets an outside edge through point. A run taken.
Around off and outside, Elgar works it wide of mid on. Angelo Mathews jogs after it and the batsmen return for the second.
LAHIRU KUMARA replaces Lakmal after just one over. Might be a change of ends for the latter.
Short and outside off, Bavuma runs it down to backward point.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Landed on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, Elgar comes down the track and flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
Goes back in his crease and blocks.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! GORGEOUS! Full and straight, Bavuma drives it straight down the ground. Well, not that straight, but good enough to beat mid on. Does not even bother to run. Moves to 10 from 20 balls with his second boundary.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Much better. The length and line are the same but this time Elgar waits for the ball to come to him  and cuts it behind point for a single.
That is a loose shot. Short and wide outside off, Elgar flays hard and misses.
Change of pace. SURANGA LAKMAL comes on to bowl.

FOUR! Lovely shot. Tossed up on middle, Bavuma comes down the track and lofts it high over mid on. Nearly goes all the way. It is referred upstairs to check whether it is a six or a four and replays confirm that the ball bounced just before the ropes.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Another easy single. Gets across and flicks it to deep mid-wicket.
Goes back and punches it towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Full and outside off, Elgar comes forward and works it towards long on for a single. We have seen that a few times from Elgar today.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
Comes over the wicket to the right-hander.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid on.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, Elgar looks to drive but misses.
Full and outside off, watchfully dead-batted.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and outside off, pushed towards long on for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Landed outside off, watchfully defended.
RANGANA HERATH to bowl from the other end.
Landed outside off, pushed towards mid on.
Full and outside off, watchfully kept out.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Comes down the track and goes over the top. Mistimes it but has enough to clear mid on. Nuwan Pradeep runs after it and saves the boundary. Two runs taken.
Landed outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.

We are back for the final session. DEAN ELGAR and TEMBA BAVUMA to continue their innings. Who will win the final session of the day and hold an edge? DHANANJAYA DE SILVA to continue his spell. Here we go...
... DAY 1, SESSION 3 ...

The next session will depend on who does well in the initial hour. If Sri Lanka strike early, they can make their way back into this game and make the match real interesting. Otherwise, they run the risk of South Africa placing themselves in a commanding position. Should be a good one. Join us in a short while for the final session of the day.

29 overs, 78 runs and just a single wicket - The session can be slightly tipped in South Africa's favour. But make no mistake, a quick wicket or two and the game can be changed in the Lankan's favour. As of now, though, the Proteas are in a comfortable position. Faf du Plessis and Dean Elgar were playing well and dealing the Lankan bowlers with ease, but then in came Rangana Herath and broke the 76-run partnership. Elgar is still unbeaten after completing his fifty and is now partnered by Temba Bavuma out there.
Goes back and works it towards square leg. TEA ON DAY 1!
Gets across, comes forward, leans and pushes it to mid on who is pretty deep. Does not take the single.
Full and around off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket again.
Goes back and across and works it towards short mid-wicket.
Goes wider outside off, Elgar reaches out and pads it away.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, Temba leans and looks to push, gets an outside edge to point.
Around off, defended from the crease.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Full and outside off, tapped away for a quick single.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to square leg.
FOUR! A short ball on middle, Elgar goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA comes on to bowl now with 5 minutes to go to Tea.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, Bavuma drives this beautifully through the covers but the fielder dives to his left to stop.
Full and just around off, the arm ball, watchfully defended.
TEMBA BAVUMA walks in at number 6, replacing Faf.

OUT! Edged and taken! So it has taken 6 overs for Herath to get a wicket. Tossed up outside off, Faf leans to drive but the ball spins away a touch, takes the outside edge and Angelo Mathews takes a simple catch. Looks like everyone is going through the motions out there. No one makes any reaction, then Faf hits the air with his bat and then Mathews starts to smile. End of a stubborn stand. The dropped catch does not count then.
Full and outside off, Faf drives it through the covers but the fielder dives to his right and stops the ball.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid on.
Outside off, left alone.
There you go... so the ball bowled previously has caused some apprehension in Elgar's mind. This is a similar delivery, slightly wider, Dean has a poke at it but misses.

That is a nice lifter. Definitely on the ball, not quite sure on the Sri Lankan moods and spirits. Pradeep comes from around the wicket, bowls this in the avenue of apprehension but Elgar is not apprehensive about it at all. Lets it go and it turns out to be a good decision as the ball comes in a long way and bounces high, with Kusal Mendis collecting it near his face.
This one comes in to the right-hander, du Plessis works it with the angle through square leg for a single.
On a good length wide outside off, left alone.
Loopy and fullish in length, just around off, Dean Elgar leans across and works it to mid-wicket.
Dipping in on the left-hander, he hits it straight back to Rangi.
Tossed up outside off, Faf du Plessis drives this wide of mid off and runs to the other end to complete the single.

Full and pitched outside off, du Plessis pushes it to covers and sets off for a run. He gets to the other end as there is a direct hit at the bowler's end. It ricochets off the stumps and this lets the batsmen take another run.
This time Dean pushes this towards long on for one.
Rangi continues being brave and tosses it up on the stumps, it's eased back down the ground towards mid on for a single.
Slightly fuller than a length, around off, pushed to the cover region. Dot ball.
Back of a length delivery outside off, with an open face Faf dabs it towards gully and picks up a single.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Outside off, a solid leave by Faf du Plessis.
Stays right behind the line of this length delivery and blocks it out.
Good length delivery outside off, the South African captain keeps the bat close to him and doesn't bother at it.
Rangana Hearth gives this some decent flight, keeps tossing it up there. Elgar clips it to mid-wicket. End of the over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Faf makes good use of his feet and gets to the pitch, works it to the mid on region for a run.
Floated ball outside off, du Plessis pushes it to the cover region for no run.
Full on the stumps, it's driven straight back to the bowler.

DROPPED! Oh my word, Tharanga. You're not going to get an easy catch than that. Should have taken it. Costly one to drop. Herath from around the wicket loops it up around off, du Plessis dances down the wicket and drives this on the up towards mid off. It's in the air for a good while and flying towards Upul. He gets to his right, crouches low and fumbles the simplest of takes. Dear, oh dear....
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! That's a sumptuous shot! It's full and wide outside off, Elgar, with excellent body balance, leans into the drive and caresses it through the gap in the covers. The placement and the timing are spot on as the ball rockets to the fence. He's been in good touch all day.
Dean Elgar defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a nice length and around off, it's left alone of the keeper to collect.
Dean Elgar plays this with soft hands. Defends this length ball which is angling in to him to the left of Nuwan Pradeep.
Length delivery around off, Elgar gets forward and with the full face of the bat blocks it in front of covers.
NUWAN PRADEEP is back on for another spell.
Loopy and fullish in length, around off, defended.
Floated on a driving length, on middle and off, it's kept out off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Makes good use of his feet here, Faf. Gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Full and flighted a lot once more, on the stumps this time, Faf du Plessis comes ahead and smothers the ball in its tracks.
Some drift, some dip and a lot of flight, beautiful from Rangi as he tosses this up, it's driven straight to the cover fielder.
Short of a length and going down leg, left alone to end the over.
Wide! It's banged in short but it's too short, wide signalled by the umpire.
Length ball around off, Elgar gets an inside edge onto his pads as he attempts to play at that.
Not much movement, on the stumps and a bit straight, it's flicked to the mid-wicket region for a single.

Fuller length ball on middle and off, it's driven down the ground for a single. There was a bit of confusion between the South African pair initially, but they completed the run comfortably in the end.

FOUR! Kumara has a change of angle and comes from around the wicket, bowls a back of a length ball around off, there isn't much bounce there and it comes at a comfortable height to Dean Elgar. He camps back and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full ball around off, driven to mid on.

Rangi fielding like he's still in his 20s. Faf steps out and drives the full ball back in his direction. Herath dives low to his right and gets a hand to it which stops the ball from going past him. Excellent stuff.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Works it towards mid-wicket again but will get a run this time.
Gives this some decent air and floats it up to Dean Elgar, the southpaw with a closed face works it to mid-wicket.
Turning in on middle and off, blocked comfortably.
Loopy and fullish in length around off, Dean comes forward and smothers the spin.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the stumps, du Plessis just works this off his pads and flicks it on the leg side for one.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Yorker outside off, du Plessis looks to squeeze it out but the cannot put bat on ball. It goes straight into the keeper's gloves.
Angling in on the hips, it's glanced through the square leg region for a couple of runs. There was a big gap there and Faf quickly called for the second. Good running between the wickets.

Length ball slanting across, Elgar does well to play that with soft hands and that saves him. The ball takes the edge and falls well short of the second slip fielder. It goes through him and so, the batsmen take a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. 2 runs off the first Rangana Herath over of this Test match.
Faf gets to the pitch of the delivery and pushes it away on the off side.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
50-run stand between Elgar and du Plessis!
Tossed up by Herath, around off, it's driven back down to long off for a single.
Floats this one up nicely around off, gives it plenty of air, it's once again played to short cover.
Starts off from around the wicket and loops it up on off, there's some dip on it as well as Faf du Plessis pushes it to short cover.
RANGANA HERATH is finally introduced into the bowling attack. He has a slip and a short leg in place...
Angling in on the hips, once again there isn't much on that occasion, du Plessis has no problem hopping across and working it through mid-wicket for one run.
Back of a length just around off, blocked.
Another one on the shorter side, on middle and off, it's pulled through backward square leg by Faf du Plessis and hence, two runs are taken.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Elgar gives it the full swing of the bat and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one. That ball kept a little low as well.
Pitched on a length, just outside off, Elgar has to lean ahead and keep it down onto the track.
Short of a length and into the body, Faf du Plessis rocks onto his back foot and pulls it along the ground through to deep mid-wicket for a comfortable single.
LAHIRU KUMARA is brought back into the attack.
Drinks are on the field now!
Full and too straight, looks to flick it fine down the leg side but misses. No run taken.
Slants this across the batsman, the keeper collects it comfortably.
Full on off, the bat twists a bit inside du Plessis' hands as he drives this towards mid on. The fielder makes a dive to his left and saves runs for his team. Keeps the batsmen to just one.
Same thing that's happened on the previous delivery. Not much movement on it and it's left alone.
Outside off, and to nobody's surprise, it's left alone.
Elgar is having no trouble keeping the scoreboard ticking here. He just turns this through square leg for a run.
OOohhhh..... That must have stung. Jagged back in sharply and catches Faf right in the box. He immediately sits down and starts his breathing exercises. Nice and slow, Faf. Nice and slow.
FOUR! Beautiful placement. Back of a length outside off, du Plessis off his back foot offers a solid punch. Pierces the gap through the covers and that will be a boundary.
Another one fired right up there, it's hit straight back down the track. Not enough power behind it to beat the two fielders.
Tad fullish in length and outside off, it's kept out off the front foot and into the track ahead.
Good leave from Faf du Plessis. It's on a fuller length outside off but he knows where his stumps are and lets the ball through.
Coming in on middle and leg, the left-hander clips this behind square on the leg side for an easy single.
Mathews makes good use of his crease. Comes from wide of the crease and angles it in, straightens up and Faf is beaten as he looks to tamely push it from inside the line.
Back of a length outside off, played to point for no run.
Well outside off, Faf shoulders his arms once more.
Good length ball outside off, left alone.
Very close to the off stump, shaping in a touch just outside off, du Plessis makes a brave leave.
Tad too straight from Mathews and Elgar brings his wrists into play. Tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.

FOUR! Shot. He's latched onto that one in a flash. Back of a length around off, Faf du Plessis picks up the length early, rocks back in a jiffy and muscles the pull over mid-wicket. Comfortably gets it across the ropes and that will be a boundary.
This length ball outside off is left alone.
Arrowed in full outside off, it's driven back down the track for a single.
Full and swinging away outside off, Dean reaches out to it and looks to drives it through the covers but is unable to make any connection.
Another excellent delivery. Once again gets it to straighten up on command and almost takes the edge. Elgar needs to be more careful here.
That's beautiful from Pradeep. He gets this to slant in, then straighten up. Squares up Elgar and beats the outside edge. Lovely piece of bowling.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Replica of the previous delivery.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Better line, just around off, blocked.
Length ball outside off, du Plessis doesn't get tempted and makes sure not to do anything rash. He lets it be.
Great effort from the fielder there. Kaushal Silva the man and he does extremely well. Dives full stretch to his right as Faf punches it firmly off the back foot. Saves vital runs for his side.
Outside off, it's punched straight to the cover fielder. Dot ball to end the over.
Angling in on middle and off, on a fuller length once more, it's worked in front of mid-wicket. No run taken.
Good length delivery very close to off, with an open-faced blade is dabbed away towards point.
This one just straightens up a touch. It's on a full length around off, angling in first then just getting straight. Goes off the outer half of Dean's bat and rolls away on the off side.
Full ball aiming the base of off stump, Dean comes ahead and does well to keep it out on the off side.
Pradeep continues from around the wicket and bowls a length ball which is well outside off, Dean Elgar has nothing to do with that.
Wide outside off, another leave to end the over.
Similar ball, same result.
Length ball outside off, Faf chooses to leave the ball alone and lets it through.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Further wide outside off, the bat is withdrawn and the ball is left alone.
Fractionally ahead of a length, outside off, that one remained untouched.
ANGELO MATHEWS is back on to bowl.
Finally gets him to play at it as he bowls this quite close to the off stump, gets it to angle in and forces Elgar to block it out.
Fourth one in a row. Another one outside off, another leave.
Wide outside off once more, left alone for the third time.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
On a good length and outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
5th Test fifty for Dean Elgar!

FOUR! Length ball outside off, Elgar just opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man. Plays it fine enough and he'll comfortably get a boundary. Brings up his fifty with that and it's a hard-fought one. Well done, lad.
NUWAN PRADEEP into the attack now.
Bat-pad but there's no short leg in place. Elgar finds himself to be a lucky man. It squirted up and was in the air for quite a while but there was nobody there. A single is taken to end the over.
On a fullish length, just around off, blocked.
Another one which is pitched right up there, it's outside off, Elgar walks across and drives it to mid off.
Lakmal has a change of angle and comes from around the wicket, angles in a fuller ball on off, it's played back down the track in the direction of the bowler.

FOUR! That is a sensational shot from Dean Elgar. Leans into the full ball, presents the full face of the bat and drives it back past mid off. Leaves the fielder there no chance as the ball runs away to the boundary line. Beautifully played.
Good length ball aiming the top of off stump, Elgar places himself behind the line of the delivery and blocks it out with a straight blade.
Full toss speared outside off, mistimed to the mid off fielder and that will be the end of the over.
FOUR! Short and way down leg, easy peasy for Faf to just pull it down the leg side and send it across the fine leg fence.
Stays rooted within his crease and keeps it out.

Shouts for a leg before but it's turned down. Good decision by the umpire. Fuller and nipping in on middle and leg, Faf du Plessis looks to flick it across the line but gets an inside edge onto his pads. And that's why the umpire did not signal it as out.
Short and angling down leg, the South African skipper goes for the big pull shot but the bounce is just too high. It goes past his glove and into the keeper's gloves.
Low full toss from Kumara, it's played off the inside half back down to mid on.
Swinging in on middle and off, Elgar with a bit of a closed face works it to mid-wicket.
A bit of extra bounce there for Suranga Lakmal. Squares du Plessis up a bit, it squirts off the shoulder of the bat towards cover-point as the batsmen take a run.
Tight line from Lakmal, keeps it very, very close to that off stump. It's dabbed away with an open face a bit square on the off side.

BIG SWING AND A MISS! Faf du Plessis really threw his bat at that but the movement away saw the ball whisker past the outside edge. Was on a full length and Faf will feel he missed out. There to be hit.
Back of a length delivery outside off, quite harmless as it's quite away from the batsman, no shot offered.
A hint of movement away, on a length and outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.

Kumara brings out the short one and bangs it in hard, completely catches Elgar by surprise. But, to the left-hander's credit, he did do well in the end to just sway a bit out of the way. Was a sharp bumper, though.
Back of a length on the stumps, it's kept down on the track by the southpaw opener off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery shaping in on the body, du Plessis swivels across and pulls it down towards fine leg for one.
Prods forward to this fuller ball and blocks it out on the off side.
Comes from wide of the crease and angles this in, it straightens up a shade as it's left alone by Faf du Plessis.
Full toss on middle and leg, Dean Elgar just wrists this through mid-wicket and jogs to the other end to complete the single.
Tailing in slightly, du Plessis comes ahead and meets it on the front foot. Ends the over with a solid block.
In the off stump channel, on a nice length, it's not bothered with by the Protea captain.
Was that an edge? Or did he play it deliberately? Seems it was deliberate but it just went off the outer half. Opened the face and ran it towards gully.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Faf du Plessis stands firm and blocks it out from within his crease.
This time the left-hander works it through the mid-wicket region and picks up a single.
Good length delivery slanting across, Dean Elgar without much foot movement leans forward and keeps it down on the track with a straight bat.
Good length delivery on the fifth stump line, Faf makes a rather comfortable leave as he withdraws his bat to let it through.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short of a length, outside off, it's punched away to the covers but it's straight to the fielder.
FOUR! Easy as they come for Faf. It's on his pads and all he has to do is tickle it fine down the leg side. Beats the diving keeper with ease and picks up a boundary to his name.
Way, way outside off, du Plessis tries to go after it but cannot do so.
Back of a length delivery outside off, du Plessis hangs back and punches it towards mid off for nothing.
LAHIRU KUMARA to bowl from the other end.
Short of a length ball outside off, Faf camps back and punches it towards extra cover. The veteran, Rangana Herath puts in a dive and keeps it down to a single.
Comes around the wicket and hurls in a length delivery on his pads, tucked neatly to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length and allows room to Dean to cash on. He camps back and punches it beautifully through the covers and the ball races to the fence. Good, solid stuff from him.
Fullish delivery outside off, Elgar comes forward and pushes it with hard hands to short covers. His top hand came off in the process.
Hurls this one on a length outside off, Elgar plants his front foot across and leaves it alone.
Bowls a length delivery on middle and leg, a bit of extra bounce there. Faf fends it towards the leg side for a run.

We are back for the second session. The players and the umpires are back for action. DEAN ELGAR AND FAF DU PLESSIS will continue their innings. Can the Lankans continue their momentum and dent the middle order of the hosts or will the home side put up a brave show? SURANGA LAKMAL to continue his spell. Here we go...
... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

The clouds are still hovering, the conditions are quite overcast and a solid breeze is still blowing across the Newlands. There's plenty of swing on offer and that will make the afternoon session an interesting one. Join us in a short while for all the action.

It seemed like the hosts would take the morning session for themselves, but then Lahiru Kumara struck gold. Bowled a peach of an over in which he first dismissed Amla, and then sent JP Duminy packing. That swung the complexion of the match completely and now, it can be said that Sri Lanka have a slight edge.

What a terrific comeback from Sri Lanka! They finished the session similar to how they started it, and it's all thanks to their young pacer, Lahiru Kumara. After Lakmal gave them a bright start by removing Cook in the very first over, South Africa made their way back into the game. Elgar and Amla were doing extremely well, seeing the swing out well and negotiating things confidently.
On a length attacking the stumps at around 144 clicks, Elgar covers the line and manages to block it out. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Fullish and straying on the pads, clipped nicely through backward square leg for a couple.
STREAKY WAY TO GET OFF THE MARK! Bowls it fullish outside off, swirling back in. Faf comes forward and looks to block it but gets a thick inside edge that rolls down to fine leg. Single taken!
Drops a short delivery and it's going down leg, left alone by the Protea skipper.
Short of a length ball outside off, du Plessis rises with the bounce and defends it down.

He is bowling with good pace! Bowls a length delivery around off, nips back in and zips through the pitch. Faf hops back to defend but is struck near the abdomen region. He is constantly troubling the batsmen.
Full length ball outside off, Elgar prods forward and pushes it to the covers.
Fullish on middle and leg, pushed off the front foot back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a length on the stumps, Elgar comes forward and defends it nicely.
Fullish delivery outside off, played with an angled blade to gully.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FAF DU PLESSIS walks out to bat.

OUT! STRANGLES DUMINY DOWN THE LEG SIDE! It has been an amazing over and he has brought Sri Lanka right back into the contest after a lean phase. Sticks to a short delivery and attacks the rib-cage of Duminy. He hops back, gets into an uncomfortable position and tries to fend it off. Ends up gloving it and Kusal Mendis moves to his right and leaps athletically into the air to grab a stunner. Absolute ripper! The 19-year old youngster is turning it around. Duminy's weakness against the short delivery has been spotted again and he has to make the long walk back.
On a length outside off, Duminy leaves it alone.
He is bending his back and has his tail up! Bowls a shortish delivery outside off, gets it to lift from the pitch. Duminy drops his wrists and lets it go through.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, driven to mid on.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
JP DUMINY comes into bat.

OUT! KUMARA SENDS AMLA BACK WITH A PEACH! The youngster is absolutely pumped up and why not, it's the big fish that he has grabbed. Bowls it fullish outside off at 143.4 clicks, Amla comes back and accross initially and then strides forward to play an ambitious drive down the ground. The inward movement is sharp and Amla leaves a huge gap between his bat and pad. The ball whizzes between  the gate and crashes into the stumps. A lot of energy into the celebration from Kumara and his skipper, Mathews is overwhelmed. Has been rewarded for bending his back and bowling his heart out.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Follows it up with a length delivery outside off, Elgar covers the line and defends it nicely.
FOUR! GOOD BALANCE! Bowls it fullish and on the pads, Elgar clips it gently through mid-wicket. The timing is spot on and he gets the desired result!
Short of a length delivery on off, rising up on Elgar. He rides the bounce and keeps it down.
Similar length ball on the pads, defended towards short leg.
On a length on middle and leg, Dean camps back and defends it.
LAKMAL is back on.

FOUR! SUPERB! What a flourish of the bat! Bowls it fullish outside off, Amla lunges forward and drives it down the ground and the ball whistles away to the fence. He is looking confident now after his nervy start.
Length delivery on off, defended off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Very full delivery outside off, pushed of the front foot to covers.
In the air... but safe! Bowls a fullish delivery and it's tailing back in, Hashim closes his bat face early and gets a leading edge towards covers which falls down safely.
On a length and it's angling down leg. Amla looks to clip it through but misses. A bit of ooh's and aah's from the Lankans.
On a length on the stumps, defended solidly off the back foot.
Sticks to the short delivery outside off, Dean looks to pull it but mistimes it towards mid on.
Wide! Drops this one way too short and Elgar ducks under it. It went way over his head to sail into the gloves of the keeper. Wide signaled by the umpire for height.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Comes around the wicket and hurls it fullish and wide outside off, Elgar doesn't flirt with that one.
Straying on the pads, nudged round the corner for a run.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, defended towards mid on.
Full delivery outside off, left alone.
Short delivery wide outside off, Elgar cuts it hard towards point but fails to bisect the field.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short of a length delivery, Elgar looks to tuck it but is struck on the thigh pad.
No ball! Digs this one short, Elgar hops back and keeps it down towards gully. Kumara overstepped on that occasion.
A bit shortish this time and it's angling across Elgar. He sways away from the line to evade it.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, Amla drives it through mid on and gets three runs for it.
Starts with a very wide delivery outside off, Amla has nothing to do with it. Mike Haysman on air mentions, that he is not lifting is bat as much in his followthrough as he did in the first Test.
LAHIRU KUMARA is into the attack. Let's see how the youngster fares.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Bowls it on a length outside off, shapes away. Elgar feels for it but is beaten.
50-run stand up between Elgar and Amla.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Straying on the hips, Elgar nudges it and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Elgar covers the line and defends it stoutly.
The sun has broken through and is shining brightly at the moment.
On a length on the stumps, defended off the back foot towards mid on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Drops this one with soft hands to the covers and scurries for a quick single.
Fuller delivery around off, Elgar looks to push it through covers with soft hands but drags it from the inner half back towards the bowler.
This time he gets squared up to the length delivery and defends it down on the track.
WELL BOWLED! Bowls it on a length around off, angles away. Elgar covers his off pole, trusts it to go away and leaves it alone safely.
Bowls it on a length and its angling away from Dean. He comes forward and allows it through.
Cranks up his pace on this occasion and bowls it fullish around off at 140.9 clicks, Elgar prods forward and defends it to the covers.
He is getting nice shape here! Bowls it in the channel outside off, nips back in. Amla covers his off pole and leaves it alone.
Hurls this one a bit fuller and it's nipping in a touch. Amla puts in a confident stride forward and defends it to the covers.
Sticks to the same length outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
On a length outside off, defended with an open face towards point.
In the corridor of uncertainty, holding its line. Hashim doesn't fiddle with it.

Good change of pace. Bowls an off cutter around off at 114.5 clicks, Elgar picks it up nicely and pushes it with soft hands through the covers for a run. Wanted the second but decides against it as the fielder was quick to reach to it.
Just a back of a length delivery outside off, Amla points his bat skywards and allows it through.
Gets this to curve back in from a fullish length, Amla is squared up a touch but manages to defend it towards point.
In the channel outside off, left alone again.
Short of a length outside off, Amla makes an easy leave.

FOUR! BEAUTIFUL! Fractionally overpitched wide outside off, Amla uses his hand-eye coordination to great effect. Doesn't move his feet much but still drives it beautifully through the covers for a cracking boundary.
On a length outside off, holding its line. Amla plants his front foot across and leaves it alone.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, clipped with soft hands towards the fielder at mid-wicket. Takes him on and completes the single comfortably at the end.
On a length and it's too straight on this ocassion, picked off his hips nicely and gets it to deep mid-wicket. Three runs taken!
On a full length and wide outside off this time, an easy leave for Elgar.
Hurls this one on a driving length outside off, Dean comes across a touch but leaves it alone at the end.
This time Mathews lands it on a length and it's angling away from Elgar. He lets it through.
Full length ball on off, Elgar puts his head down and defends it calmly back towards the bowler.
Time for Drinks.
Shortish and wide outside off, Hashim cuts it hard to the man at backward point.
Fullish delivery outside off, shapes in. Amla covers his off pole and lets it through.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Length delivery coming back, Hashim looks to tuck it but is struck on the thigh pad.
Taps this one with soft hands towards covers and scurries through for a sharp single.
FOUR! SHOT! Comes around the wicket and bowls a length ball outside off, Elgar drives it with an open face through covers and the ball races to the fence.
NUWAN PRADEEP is back on.
This one shapes in a touch as Amla comes forward and blocks it to the off side. A great over by Mathews.
Length delivery outside off, shaping away. Amla goes back and pokes at it but gets beaten all ends up.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

Gets this one to swing back in and it's on a fuller length. When the ball swings both ways the batsman is caught off guard and that's what is happening with Amla. He is looking shaky out there. He comes forward tentatively and manages to defend it down the track.
This time he hurls it wide outside off, Hashim doesn't fiddle with it.
CLASS BOWLING FROM MATHEWS! Bowls it fullish outside off, gets it to curve away appreciably. Amla is drawn into a false stroke and the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
FOUR! WELL PLAYED! Bowls it fullish on the stumps, Elgar lunges forward and just pushes it through the vacant mid on region for a superb boundary.

Slips this one down the leg side, Elgar clips it uppishly and it just flies over the left hand of the fielder at short leg. That was too close for comfort. Rolls through to deep backward square leg. Couple taken!
Too straight on this occasion, glanced to fine leg for a run.
Camps back to the length delivery and buries it into the ground down the track.
Fullish and straying on the pads, nudged round the corner for a run.
On a length outside off, Elgar covers the line and defends it nicely.
Full delivery outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second
On a length outside off, shaping away. Amla looks to push it but gets an outside edge through the slip cordon. Couple taken!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Leg bye! Well run! Bowls it on a length on the stumps, Elgar looks to clip it but is struck on the thigh pad. Good running to come across for a run.

ALMOST GOT A WICKET OFF HIS FIRST BALL! Hurls this one full and outside off and invites Elgar for a drive. He prods forward to drive but the balance is not quite there. The ball whizzes past his outside edge.
ANGELO MATHEWS comes into the attack.
Full delivery outside off, Amla looks to drive it but drags it off the inner half towards mid off.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Sprays this one down the leg side, Hashim looks to clip it but misses and is struck low on the pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
LOOSE SHOT! Shortish delivery wide outside off, Amla slashes at it but misses.

Ooh.. THAT LOOKED CLOSE! Bowls a fullish length ball outside off, shapes in after pitching. Amla looks to defend it but misses and is hit flush on the front pad. There is a huge appeal for LBW from the Lankans but the umpire stays unmoved. Mathews looks at his bowler for review but then after a discussion with his keeper decides against taking it. Good decision to not take it as the Hawk Eye shows that the impact was outside off.
Short of a length ball, angling in. Elgar hops back and defends it down the track.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
On a good length, defended to the leg side.

Nuwan Pradeep stopped in his followthrough there. The replays show that his left elbow caught umpire Dar on his right arm. Dar shouted out in spin immediately which made Pradeep not to release ball from his hands. Rangana Herath then dives Dar a massage and he seems to be fine now.
Wide outside off, Elgar makes an easy leave.
A bit fuller on this ocassion, Elgar points his bat skywards and allows it through.
Comes around the wicket and angles in a length delivery. Elgar covers the line and defends it nicely.
On a length around off, defended solidly off the back foot.
FOUR! DELIGHTFUL! Slightly overpitched outside off, Amla lunges forward and with an open face drives it elegantly through the covers. It looked like a certain boundary the moment it left his bat.
Full delivery and straying on the pads, clipped towards fine leg for a run.
GOOD GAME AWARENESS! This time he taps it with soft hands towards covers and comes across for a brisk single.
Fullish delivery swinging in, Amla lunges forward and blocks it into the ground.
Length delivery around off, Hashim covers the line and defends it to the off side.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, clipped nicely through mid-wicket and good running between the wicket allows them to come back for the third.
THAT CUT HIM INTO TWO HALVES! Bowls a length delivery outside off, nipping in a lot. Amla looks to leave it initially but plays at it at the last moment. Gets beaten all ends up!
Fullish length ball outside off, holding its line. Amla steers it towards the man at point.
Short of a length ball wide outside off, played with an angled blade to point.
Fullish delivery curving back into Hashim. He defends it towards mid-wicket.
On a length, angling in. Amla comes forward and defends it to the off side.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
On a driving length this time and it's around off, Dean is again caught in the crease. He finally comes forward and defends it down the track.
Back of a length ball on off, Elgar hops back and defends it past the short leg fielder.

AMLA GETS OFF THE MARK AFTER A TENTATIVE START! Bowls it fullish outside off, Amla comes forward and drives it beautifully through the vacant mid off region. Good timing on that one and that will boost his confidence!
Short of a length ball outside off, shaping back in. Amla points his bat skywards and allows it through.
On a length outside off, holding its line. Amla doesn't fiddle with it.
On a length, angling away. Played towards gully with an angled blade.
Hurls in a full length ball outside off again luring Elgar into a false shot. He resists the temptation and allows it through.
On a length outside off, angling away. Elgar plants his front foot forward and leaves it alone.
Fullish length ball outside off, left alone.
Fullish delivery shaping away from Dean. He pushes at it tentatively off his front foot but drags it from the inner half towards mid on.
Short of a length ball attacking the body, Elgar defends it to short leg.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Hashim lets it through.

THAT'S A PEACH! Amla didn't have any clue about that one. Bowls a full length ball outside off and Amla is drawn forward to that one. The ball moves away substantially and beats the tentative front foot push of Amla. He was lucky not to nick that one behind.
Straying on the pads, nudged round the corner for a run.
On a length and angling away, Dean gets behind the line and defends it solidly to the off side.
Fullish delivery on middle and off, Elgar is a bit tentative with his foot movement as he comes half-forward and defends it down.
FOUR! FIRST BOUNDARY OF THE MATCH! On a length and straying on the hips, Elgar gets a fine tickle on it and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Slips this one down the leg side, Amla looks to clip it but misses.
In the channel outside off, holding its line. Another leave by Amla. There has been good carry on this track so far. Good signs for the pace bowlers, they will enjoy bowling on this track.
GOOD LEAVE! Bowls it just back of a length outside off, shaping in and zips through the pitch. Amla doesn't flirt with that one.
Bowls a fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Amla prods forwards and defends it to the covers.
Good shot! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Dean comes forward and punches it nicely through the covers. The timing is good on that one and he gets off the mark with three runs.
Bowls a fullish delivery on leg stump, Elgar looks to clip it through but misses and is rapped on the front pad. A stifled appeal for LBW turned down. That one was probably going down leg.
NUWAN PRADEEP to bowl from the other end.
Short of a length ball outside off, moves away after pitching. Amla sees it through safely.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
HASHIM AMLA comes out to bat at no. 3.

OUT! LAKMAL STRIKES! The hero of the first Test departs. Just the start the Lankans would have wanted. Bowls just a back of a length ball outside off, shapes away appreciably. Cook hops back and pokes at it tamely but gets a thick outside edge that flies towards Mendis behind the stumps. He makes no mistake and takes a regulation catch. Can they keep on putting the pressure on the home side?
In the corridor of uncertainty, Stephen doesn't fiddle with that one.
This length delivery comes back in! Good use of swing by Lakmal. Cook looks to defend it but misses and is struck on the thigh pad.
A good start for Lakmal! Bowls it on a length outside off, shapes away a touch. Cook points his bat skywards and lets it through.

We are ready for the first session. The players and the umpires come out in the middle. STEPHEN COOK and DEAN ELGAR will open the batting for South Africa. Can they lay a solid foundation for their middle order or will the Lankan pacers make use of the overcast conditions to nip out two or three quick wickets? SURANGA LAKMAL to start with the new cherry. Here we go...

Team Changes - South Africa have named an unchanged side for the second Test while there are two changes for Sri Lanka - UPUL THARANGA comes in for Kusal Perera while Dushmantha Chameera makes way for LAHIRU KUMARA.
SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD FIRST!

On the other hand, the Islanders were good in patches with bat and ball but lost the game due to the failure to click together as a unit. They have a young side and some exciting players in their ranks. They would look up to the likes of Matthews, Herath and Chandimal and it is big time that the experienced campaigners pave the way for them. Will the home side seal the series here itself or will the visitors show mettle and get back to winning ways? A cracker of a contest at the picturesque Newlands awaits!

Hello and a warm welcome for Day 1 of the second Test between South Africa and Sri Lanka. The home side will be brimming with confidence after their brilliant all-round show in the first Test. Stephen Cook constructed his innings brilliantly in both the innings and the hosts will be banking upon him to continue his good run. Their skipper, Faf du Plessis is enjoying the role of captaincy and inspiring his side to deliver their best. While, their pace attack is arguably the best in the world and they would be excited at the prospect of bowling on a lush green Newlands surface.
